svg.font-family: Inter, 'Source Sans 3', 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: Optimize the policy directly on preference pairs.
Implicit reward: r*(x,y) = beta x log [ pi_theta(y|x) / pi_ref(y|x) ]
loss = -log sigma( r*(x, y_w) - r*(x, y_l) )
This is negative log-likelihood under Bradley-Terry.
The policy IS the reward model: no separate r(x,y) is ever fit.
beta sets how far pi may drift from pi_ref (the identification anchor).
Worked: log-ratio gaps 0.5 and -0.3, beta=1 -> gap 0.8 -> sigma = 0.69 -> loss 0.37.
Source: textbook ch 1.2 eq 1.2-1.3, original plate. Shell 4: the loss.
